title: GcRunner run_once uses now_ms + elapsed for completed_at — double-counting if now_ms is stale
description: gc.rs GcRunner::run_once receives now_ms as a parameter (set by start_gc_scheduler before calling run_once). It then adds start.elapsed().as_millis() to now_ms to compute completed_at_ms. If now_ms was captured even a few seconds before run_once starts (e.g. due to scheduling jitter), completed_at will be wrong. The start.elapsed() should be added to a fresh SystemTime::now() call taken at the start of run_once, not to the externally-provided now_ms.
